about: 20 questions about our records. 'right_answer' is what the live record held on 2026-11-11 (data built 2026-09-24). 'check' says how run_checks.py tests it against the output of scripts/aa.py. This tests our data path, not a model. If a record is rebuilt, a changed answer is a finding to read, not always a bug.

questions.question: What stay limit does the record hold for Beartooth WMA (Montana)?
What stay limit does the record hold for Chester City Park (Montana)?
What stay limit does the record hold for Cliff Point Campground (Montana)?

Does the season record read open or closed for Beaver Creek Campground (Montana) on July 15, 2027?
questions.right_answer: open (record: May 15 to Sep 27, weather dependent; confirm with the Forest Service office)

questions.question: Does the season record read open or closed for Beaver Creek Campground on December 1, 2027? (A trip we would not plan, but the record answers.)

questions.right_answer: yes, all free; each needs its record url

questions.question: Does a search for 'hyalite' return camp records that each carry a record url?
Where does the fuel layer say its points come from, and what credit does it need?
questions.right_answer: OpenStreetMap, via the Overpass API; credit (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)

questions.question: Is the forecast for a point near Hyalite from the National Weather Service, with periods?
questions.right_answer: yes, NWS periods, quoted as written (the forecast changes every hour, so only its shape is checked)
